extraction.notes: Three-month 2023 column only. Reconciliation ties: net loss -5,051 + FFO adjustments = FFO 47,720; + core adjustments = Core FFO 11,626; Core FFO + AFFO adjustments = Core AFFO 13,895. Shares 100,936 (thousands) reproduce $0.47 FFO and $0.12 Core FFO per share. Zero-amount Q4 lines (discontinued JV gain, discontinued impairments/D&A, Rockpoint buyout premium, redemption value adjustment, lease breakage fee, Operating Services severance, market lease intangibles) are included as printed with amount 0. Judgment calls: 'Land and other impairments' categorized as other (non-depreciable land); 'Amortization of derivative premium' categorized as debt_cost_amortization; straight-line-type items (market lease intangibles, lease inducements) categorized as straight_line_rent; the three capex lines are the company's non-incremental revenue-generating capex deducted in AFFO, categorized as recurring_capex. Company reports no per-share AFFO figure. Capex is already deducted in AFFO so recurring_capex_disclosed is null.
